name: speedrun mode
description: An in-game timer in the game's font: real time (RTA) and in-game time (IGT: the frames the game is Playing or Watching -- loads, menus and the pause stop it), splits on every level entry and exit written into the pad-log recording (`# split` lines) so a run is verifiable; practice save states on a ring of 8 slots (F9 save, F10 load the newest, F11 the one before; separate from the engine's F5/F8), F12 = reset to run start.
